wizard.title: Create project
wizard.description: Set up a project inbox in three steps: name it, point to the directory, then decide whether it should manage multiple workspaces.

basics.label: Project name
basics.help: Give the project a concise working name. You can rename the display label later.

errors.short: Project name must be at least 3 characters.
errors.long: Project name must be 100 characters or fewer.

directory.directoryHelp: Use an existing local folder, or choose the target path where a repository clone should land.
directory.gitUrlHelp: Optional. If provided, the wizard clones the repository first, then registers the cloned folder as the project directory.

errors.missingLocalPath: That local directory does not exist yet. Use Browse to pick or create a folder, or provide a git repository URL.

validation.missing: Folder not found. Use Browse to choose or create an existing local directory.
validation.cloneTargetMissing: Folder not found yet. That is okay if the repository clone will create it.

workspace.title: Enable multi-workspace management
workspace.description: Turn this on if the project should expose multiple git worktree-backed workspaces in the Phase 2 inbox and git flows.
workspace.warningBody: The toggle changes how this project is managed from now on. Keep it off unless you need parallel worktree streams inside one project.
workspace.enabledDetails: Active workspaces will be surfaced in the inbox header, session cards, and git tooling as named worktree contexts.
